warm-steak-kale.name: Warm Steak, Kale & Sweet Potato Salad
warm-steak-kale.pitch: Seared garlic-thyme steak over massaged kale with browned sweet potato — high protein, veggie-forward, light balsamic finish.
ingredients: Olive oil, cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Wash and dry produce. Dice sweet potato into ½-inch pieces. In a large microwave-safe bowl, toss sweet potato with half the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Add 2 Tbsp butter, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and microwave until tender and steaming, 6–7 minutes. Remove wrap and stir.

Meanwhile, strip any large stems from kale and chop leaves if desired. Place kale in a second large bowl. Massage with a large drizzle of olive oil (like kneading dough) until leaves soften and darken, 1–2 minutes — this keeps kale tender, not fibrous.

Pat steak dry with paper towels; thinly slice against the grain. Heat a drizzle of cooking oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add steak; season with half the dried thyme (all for 4 servings), remaining garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, to desired doneness, 3–6 minutes (beef is done at 145°F). Transfer steak to a plate. Wipe out pan and let cool slightly.
Return pan to high heat; add microwaved sweet potato. Cook, stirring constantly, until edges are browned, 30–60 seconds. Turn off heat; tip sweet potato into the bowl with kale.

Reserve 4 tsp balsamic dressing in a small bowl for finishing. Add Parmesan to kale and sweet potato; drizzle with as much remaining dressing as you like and toss. Divide salad between plates, top with steak, drizzle reserved dressing, and sprinkle with pecans and cranberries. Serve.

sesame-ginger-steak.name: Sesame Ginger Steak Salad
sesame-ginger-steak.pitch: Quick seared steak over mixed greens with cucumber and tomato — carb-conscious, no heavy cream sauces.
ingredients: 2 Tbsp olive oil + cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Wash and dry produce. Quarter lime. Trim and thinly slice cucumber into rounds. Halve grape tomatoes.

Pat steak dry; thinly slice crosswise. Toss in a medium bowl with sesame ginger crunch seasoning, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook, stirring occasionally, to desired doneness, 3–5 minutes. In the last minute, stir in garlic-ginger scallion paste, half the sweet Thai chili sauce, and juice from 1 lime wedge (2 wedges for 4 servings).
Meanwhile, whisk rice wine vinegar, remaining chili sauce, 2 Tbsp olive oil, and juice from 1 lime wedge (use 4 Tbsp oil and 2 wedges for 4) in a small bowl for the dressing.

In a large bowl, toss mixed greens, cucumber, and tomatoes with as much dressing as you like; taste and season with salt and pepper. Divide salad into shallow bowls, top with glazed steak, and garnish with crispy fried onions and peanuts. Serve with remaining lime wedges.

steak-nicoise.name: Steak Niçoise Salad
steak-nicoise.pitch: Provençal steak salad with green beans, potatoes, tomatoes, and olives — lighter bistro plate, vinaigrette over creamy sauces.
ingredients: 2 Tbsp olive oil + cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Wash and dry produce. Cut potatoes into 1-inch pieces. Place potatoes and half the garlic herb butter in a medium microwave-safe bowl; season with salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave until tender, 6–7 minutes. Remove wrap.

Meanwhile, trim green beans if needed and halve widthwise. Trim root end from lettuce; chop leaves into bite-size pieces. Roughly chop olives. Place green beans in a second microwave-safe bowl, cover tightly, and microwave until tender, 2–3 minutes.

Pat steak dry; season with half the herbes de Provence (rest goes in the dressing), salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Sear steak 3–6 minutes per side to desired doneness (145°F). Transfer to a cutting board to rest.

Optional: Halve and toast baguette; spread cut sides with remaining garlic herb butter; cut each piece on a diagonal. In a large bowl, whisk white wine vinegar, Dijon, remaining herbes de Provence, 1 Tbsp olive oil (2 Tbsp for 4), salt, and pepper.

Add lettuce, potatoes, green beans, tomatoes, and olives to the dressing; toss to coat. Thinly slice steak against the grain. Divide salad between plates, top with steak, and serve garlic bread alongside if using.

italian-steak-broccoli.name: Italian-Style Steak & Roasted Baby Broccoli
italian-steak-broccoli.pitch: Balsamic-marinated seared steak with roasted baby broccoli and arugula panzanella — veggie-heavy, sodium-smart.
ingredients: Olive oil (~3 Tbsp), cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Adjust oven rack to middle; preheat to 425°F. Wash and dry produce. Trim woody ends from baby broccoli. Tear ciabatta into bite-size pieces. Slice cucumber into ½-inch rounds; halve tomatoes. Halve, peel, and thinly slice half the onion (all for 4); soak slices in a medium bowl of ice water.

Toss baby broccoli on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, half the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Toss ciabatta on the empty side with a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast until broccoli is tender and ciabatta is crisped, 12–15 minutes.

Meanwhile, pat steak dry; season with salt and pepper. In a medium bowl, combine balsamic vinegar, dried rosemary, and 1 Tbsp olive oil (2 Tbsp for 4). Add steak, turn to coat, and marinate while veggies roast, turning occasionally.

In a large bowl, whisk sherry vinegar, honey, Dijon, remaining garlic powder, 1 Tbsp olive oil (2 Tbsp for 4), salt, and pepper. Drain onion, pat dry, and add with cucumber, tomatoes, and roasted ciabatta croutons; toss to coat.

Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Let excess marinade drip off steak; sear 5–7 minutes per side to desired doneness. Discard leftover marinade. Transfer steak to a cutting board and rest at least 5 minutes.

Add arugula to the salad bowl and toss. Thinly slice steak against the grain. Plate steak; grate half the Parmesan over it. Serve roasted baby broccoli and arugula panzanella alongside; grate remaining Parmesan over the salad.

tuscan-chicken-succotash.name: Tuscan Chicken & Tomato-Basil Succotash
tuscan-chicken-succotash.pitch: Oven-roasted spice-rubbed chicken over blistered zucchini, corn, pepper, and tomatoes — high protein, carb-conscious, light lemon aioli.
ingredients: 10–12 oz chicken cutlets (kit packs 24 oz; use half for 2)
1 tsp Tuscan Heat Spice (measure; kit sends more)
Olive oil, cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Adjust rack to top position (top and middle for 4) and preheat oven to 425°F. Wash and dry produce. Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch pieces. Thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Core, deseed, and dice bell pepper into ¼-inch pieces. Drain corn if needed. Zest and quarter lemon.

Pat chicken dry. Season all over with a drizzle of olive oil, 1 tsp Tuscan Heat Spice (2 tsp for 4 — measure; kit sends more), salt, and pepper. Place on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Roast on top rack until cooked through (165°F), 15–18 minutes.

While chicken roasts, heat a large drizzle of oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and tomatoes; cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is browned and tomatoes blister, 3–4 minutes. Add scallion whites, bell pepper, and corn (add more oil if pan seems dry). Season with salt and pepper; cook until lightly browned, 2–3 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in basil paste.
In a small bowl, combine lemon zest, mayonnaise, garlic powder, and juice from 1 lemon wedge (2 wedges for 4) to make lemon garlic aioli.
Divide succotash between plates. Top with chicken; spread aioli over chicken. Sprinkle with scallion greens and serve remaining lemon wedges on the side.

chicken-veggie-feta.name: Roasted Chicken, Potatoes & Veggie-Feta Jumble
chicken-veggie-feta.pitch: Sheet-pan roasted chicken with Mediterranean potatoes and zucchini–carrot–onion jumble finished with feta — GLP-1 friendly, ~590 kcal.
steps: Adjust racks to top and middle; preheat oven to 425°F. Wash and dry produce. Dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Peel and cut carrots on a diagonal into ½-inch pieces. Trim zucchini and cut on a diagonal into ½-inch rounds. Halve, peel, and cut onion into ½-inch wedges.

Toss potatoes on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, garlic powder, half the Mediterranean spice blend (all for 4), and salt. (Line with parchment or foil for easy cleanup.) Toss carrots, zucchini, and onion on the empty side with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack for 5 minutes (they finish in the next step).

Meanwhile, pat chicken dry; season with a drizzle of oil, half the fry seasoning (all for 4), salt, and pepper. Place on a second lightly oiled baking sheet. After veggies have roasted 5 minutes, move that sheet to the middle rack and put chicken on the top rack. Roast until veggies are browned and tender and chicken reaches 165°F, 18–22 minutes.
Transfer carrots, zucchini, and onion to a large bowl; add feta and toss. Slice chicken crosswise on a cutting board. Divide chicken, veggie-feta jumble, and potatoes between plates. Serve.

spiced-chicken-yogurt.name: Spiced Chicken Cutlets with Roasted Vegetables & Lemon Yogurt Sauce
spiced-chicken-yogurt.pitch: Shawarma-spiced cutlets with roasted veg and lemon yogurt — Calorie Smart / Mediterranean, yogurt sauce instead of cream.
steps: Adjust rack to top (top and middle for 4); preheat oven to 425°F. Wash and dry produce. Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Zest and quarter lemon. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; thinly slice into half-moons. Halve, peel, and cut onion into ½-inch wedges.

Toss potatoes on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, Turkish spice blend, and a big pinch of salt and pepper (for 4, spread potatoes across the whole sheet). Roast on top rack for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine garlic, shawarma spice, a large drizzle of oil, juice from half the lemon, salt, and pepper. Pat chicken dry; add to bowl and turn to coat. Set aside to marinate.

In a medium bowl, toss zucchini and onion with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Once potatoes have roasted 10 minutes, remove sheet. Carefully add veggies and chicken to the empty side (for 4, leave potatoes roasting and use a second sheet on the middle rack). Return to top rack until potatoes and veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through (165°F), 15–20 minutes.
Meanwhile, mash feta in a small bowl. Stir in sour cream (or yogurt), lemon zest, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Thin with water 1 tsp at a time until drizzle-able.
Divide chicken, roasted veggies, and potato wedges between plates. Serve with lemon feta crema for drizzling or dipping, plus remaining lemon wedges.
spiced-chicken-yogurt.note: Exact HF card 'Spiced Chicken Cutlets with Roasted Vegetables and Lemon Yogurt Sauce' omitted steps on the public page; using the matching Sheet Pan Spiced Chicken Cutlets (shawarma/Turkish spices, roasted veg, lemon feta crema) as the kit-equivalent.

classic-roasted-salmon.name: Classic Roasted Salmon
classic-roasted-salmon.pitch: Oven-roasted salmon with green beans, burst tomatoes, and crispy potato rounds — ~560 kcal, omega-3s, no heavy cream sauce.
ingredients: 1 Tbsp olive oil (+ more for pan/sheet)
steps: Wash and dry all produce. Preheat oven to 425°F. Fill a large pot with salted water and bring to a boil. Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Thinly slice garlic. Pick dill fronds and finely chop. Slice potatoes into ½-inch-thick rounds.

When water boils, add green beans; cook until bright green, 1–2 minutes. Lift out with a slotted spoon into a strainer and rinse under cold water (keep pot boiling). Add potatoes to the same pot; boil until easily pierced with a knife, 12–15 minutes. Drain and let cool slightly.

Meanwhile, melt 1 Tbsp butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add tomatoes; season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing, until slightly wilted, 2–3 minutes. Add green beans and garlic; cook until tender, 2–3 minutes. Stir in half the dill; season. Remove from pan, cover, and keep warm.
Place salmon skin-side down on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil; season with salt and pepper. Roast to desired doneness, 8–10 minutes (fish is done at 145°F).

When potatoes are cool enough to handle, lightly crush each round with the back of a knife. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in the veggie pan over medium-high heat. Add potatoes and cook until browned, 2–3 minutes per side (work in batches if needed). Sprinkle with remaining dill; season with salt and pepper.
Divide green beans and tomatoes, salmon, and crispy potato rounds between plates. Serve.

soy-glazed-salmon-kale.name: Sweet Soy-Glazed Salmon & Kale Salad
soy-glazed-salmon-kale.pitch: Seared salmon over sesame kale–slaw salad with quick pickles — Protein Smart / Carb Smart, no fried sides.
ingredients: 2 tsp olive oil + 1 tsp cooking oil, ½ tsp sugar, salt, pepper
steps: Wash and dry produce. Pat salmon dry; season all over with salt and pepper. Drizzle oil in a hot large pan. Cook salmon skin-sides down until skin is crisp, 5–7 minutes. Flip and cook until cooked through, 1–2 minutes more (145°F). Transfer to a plate and drizzle with as much sweet soy glaze as you like. (Start pickles while salmon cooks.)

Thinly slice onion. In a small microwave-safe bowl, mix onion, shredded carrots, rice wine vinegar, ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4), salt, and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap; microwave 1–2 minutes. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally.

Strip large stems from kale; chop if desired. Place in a large bowl and massage with a large drizzle of olive oil until leaves are tender, about 1 minute. Add coleslaw mix; season with salt and pepper. Add 1 tsp pickling liquid (2 tsp for 4) and as much sesame dressing as you like; toss.
Top salad with glazed salmon and drained pickled veggies to taste. Sprinkle with peanuts (toast them first if you have an extra minute) and serve.

cajun-sheet-salmon.name: Sheet Pan Cajun Salmon with Asparagus & Sweet Potato
cajun-sheet-salmon.pitch: One-pan Cajun-spiced salmon with roasted sweet potato and asparagus — baked not fried; light spiced yogurt/sour cream drizzle.
ingredients: 1 Tbsp Cajun spice blend (smoked paprika, mustard, onion/garlic powder, oregano, thyme, cayenne)
½ Tbsp weeknight hero spice blend (onion/garlic powder, smoked paprika, parsley)
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F. Wash and dry produce. Medium-dice sweet potato. Snap off tough woody ends of asparagus. Quarter and deseed lemon. In a bowl, combine Cajun spice blend and brown sugar.

Line two sheet pans with foil. Spread diced sweet potato on one pan; drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and half the weeknight hero spice blend. Toss and arrange in an even layer. Roast 20–24 minutes until lightly browned and fork-tender.

Meanwhile, pat salmon dry; season both sides with salt and pepper. Place on one side of the second pan. Coat with enough Cajun–sugar mixture (you may have extra) and drizzle with olive oil. Roast 10 minutes. Leaving oven on, add asparagus to the other side of the pan; season with salt and pepper and drizzle with oil. Roast 8–12 minutes more until asparagus is fork-tender and salmon reaches 145°F. Squeeze juice from 2 lemon wedges (4 for 4 servings) over asparagus and toss.

In a bowl, mix sour cream, remaining weeknight hero spice, 2 tsp water (4 tsp for 4), and as much hot sauce as you like; season with salt and pepper. Plate salmon with roasted sweet potato and asparagus; drizzle with spiced sour cream. Serve remaining lemon wedges on the side.

garlic-butter-steak-bites.name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites with Creamy Mashed Potatoes
garlic-butter-steak-bites.pitch: Seared steak bites in garlic butter over rich mashed potatoes and green beans — comfort-food classic.
steps: Wash and dry produce. Dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Trim green beans. Mince garlic. Pat steak dry; cut into ¾-inch cubes; season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.

Place potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 1 inch. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, 12–15 minutes. Drain; return to pot. Mash with 1 Tbsp butter, sour cream, and milk until creamy. Season with salt and pepper; cover to keep warm.

Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high. Add steak bites in a single layer; sear undisturbed 2 minutes, then toss and cook to desired doneness, 2–4 minutes more (145°F). Transfer to a plate.

Reduce heat to medium. Add remaining 2 Tbsp butter and minced garlic to the pan; cook until fragrant, 30–60 seconds. Return steak; toss to coat. In a second pan or the same after wiping, sauté green beans with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper until crisp-tender, 4–6 minutes.
Plate mashed potatoes, top with garlic butter steak bites, and serve green beans alongside. Spoon any pan butter over the steak.

cheeseburger-bowl.name: Loaded Cheeseburger Bowls with Crispy Potatoes
cheeseburger-bowl.pitch: Seasoned ground beef, melted cheddar, pickles, and special sauce over crispy potatoes — all the burger vibes, no bun required.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Wash and dry produce. Dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Dice tomato. In a small bowl, mix ketchup, mayo, and mustard for special sauce.
Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, fry seasoning, salt, and pepper. Roast until crispy, 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway.

Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high. Add ground beef; cook, breaking up, until browned and cooked through, 4–6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle cheddar over beef; cover briefly to melt, 1 minute.
Divide crispy potatoes between bowls. Top with cheesy beef, diced tomato, and pickle chips. Drizzle with special sauce and serve.

mushroom-swiss-steak.name: Mushroom-Swiss Steak with Herb Butter Broccoli
mushroom-swiss-steak.pitch: Pan-seared steak topped with sautéed mushrooms and melted Swiss — rich and savory, with herb butter broccoli.
steps: Wash and dry produce. Slice mushrooms. Mince garlic. Pat steak dry; season generously with salt and pepper.

Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high. Sear steak 4–6 minutes per side to desired doneness (145°F). In the last minute, top with Swiss cheese; cover until melted. Transfer to a cutting board; rest 5 minutes.
In the same pan, add mushrooms and a pinch of salt. Cook until browned and moisture evaporates, 5–7 minutes. Add half the garlic and half the butter; toss 30 seconds. Remove mushrooms.
Add broccoli, remaining garlic, thyme, remaining butter, and a splash of water. Cover and steam-sauté until bright green and tender, 4–6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Slice steak against the grain. Plate with mushroom topping and herb butter broccoli.

korean-beef-bowls.name: Korean-Style Beef Bowls with Cucumber Salad
korean-beef-bowls.pitch: Sweet-savory gochujang beef over rice with quick pickled cucumber — bold flavor, weeknight-fast.
steps: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce to low; cook until tender, 15–18 minutes. Fluff and keep covered.
Thinly slice cucumber and scallions (whites and greens separate). Toss cucumber with rice vinegar, a pinch of salt, and half the scallion greens; set aside to pickle.

Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high. Add beef and scallion whites; cook, breaking up, until browned, 4–5 minutes. Stir in gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic powder, and sesame oil; simmer 1–2 minutes until glossy.
Divide rice between bowls; top with Korean beef and cucumber salad. Garnish with remaining scallion greens and sesame seeds if using.

honey-garlic-chicken.name: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs with Broccoli Rice
honey-garlic-chicken.pitch: Sticky honey-garlic glazed thighs with steamed broccoli over fluffy rice — crowd-pleaser sweet-savory.
steps: Cook rice: combine rice, 1¼ cups water, and a pinch of salt in a small pot. Bring to boil, cover, low heat 15–18 minutes.
Pat chicken dry; season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Mince garlic. In a bowl, whisk honey, soy sauce, cornstarch, and 2 Tbsp water for glaze.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high. Sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until cooked through (165°F). Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium. Add garlic; cook 30 seconds. Pour in glaze; simmer until thickened, 1–2 minutes. Return chicken and coat.
Meanwhile, steam or microwave broccoli until tender, 3–4 minutes; season. Serve chicken and glaze over rice with broccoli.

crispy-chicken-parm.name: Crispy Chicken Parmesan with Spaghetti
crispy-chicken-parm.pitch: Breaded cutlets topped with marinara and mozzarella over spaghetti — classic Italian-American comfort.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Beat egg in a shallow bowl. Mix panko, half the Parmesan, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper in another.
Pat chicken dry. Dip in egg, then press into panko mixture. Heat a thin layer of oil in a large pan over medium-high; cook cutlets until golden, 3–4 minutes per side. Transfer to a baking sheet.
Top each cutlet with marinara and torn mozzarella. Bake until cheese melts and chicken reaches 165°F, 6–8 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti until al dente; drain. Toss with a spoonful of marinara and remaining Parmesan.
Plate spaghetti; top with chicken parm. Serve extra marinara on the side.

lemon-herb-chicken-orzo.name: Lemon Herb Chicken with Orzo & Spinach
lemon-herb-chicken-orzo.pitch: Bright lemon-herb chicken over orzo with wilted spinach and Parmesan — light but satisfying.
steps: Zest and quarter lemon. Mince garlic. Pat chicken dry; season with oregano, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high. Cook chicken 3–5 minutes per side until 165°F. Transfer to a plate; squeeze 1 lemon wedge over top.
In the same pan, toast orzo 1 minute. Add garlic; cook 30 seconds. Add 1¾ cups water and a pinch of salt; simmer, stirring, until orzo is tender and liquid absorbed, 8–10 minutes.
Stir in spinach, lemon zest, juice from 1 wedge, Parmesan, and a drizzle of olive oil until spinach wilts. Season to taste.
Slice chicken. Serve over lemon orzo with remaining lemon wedges.

bbq-chicken-salad.name: BBQ Chicken Chopped Salad with Ranch
bbq-chicken-salad.pitch: Grilled-style BBQ chicken over crisp romaine with corn, tomato, cheddar, and ranch — hearty salad night.
ingredients: 1 ear / unit corn (or ½ cup thawed)
steps: Pat chicken dry; season with chili powder, salt, and pepper. Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high; cook chicken 3–5 minutes per side until 165°F. Brush with BBQ sauce in the last minute. Rest, then slice.
Chop romaine. Halve tomatoes. If using fresh corn, cut kernels from cob (or warm thawed corn briefly in the pan).
Toss romaine, tomatoes, and corn with half the ranch. Divide into bowls; top with sliced BBQ chicken, cheddar, and remaining ranch. Serve.

thai-basil-chicken.name: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice
thai-basil-chicken.pitch: Spicy-savory basil chicken with peppers over rice — takeout energy, skillet speed.
steps: Cook rice with 1¼ cups water and a pinch of salt: boil, cover, low 15–18 minutes.
Dice pepper and onion. Mince garlic. Roughly chop basil. Mix soy, oyster sauce, chili garlic, and sugar in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a large pan or wok over high heat. Stir-fry chicken until nearly cooked, 3–4 minutes. Add pepper, onion, and garlic; cook until crisp-tender, 2–3 minutes.
Pour in sauce; toss until glossy and chicken is 165°F, 1–2 minutes. Off heat, fold in basil.
Serve over jasmine rice.

creamy-tuscan-salmon.name: Creamy Tuscan Salmon with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
creamy-tuscan-salmon.pitch: Pan-seared salmon in a rich sun-dried tomato cream sauce with spinach — restaurant-luxe at home.
steps: Pat salmon dry; season with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high. Sear salmon skin-side down 5–6 minutes; flip and cook 2–3 minutes more to 145°F. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium. Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes; cook 1 minute. Pour in cream; simmer 2 minutes. Stir in Parmesan until melted; fold in spinach until wilted. Season.
Return salmon to pan or plate and spoon creamy Tuscan sauce over top. Serve.

miso-glazed-salmon.name: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Sesame Broccoli
miso-glazed-salmon.pitch: Umami miso-maple salmon with sesame-roasted broccoli and rice — balanced and weeknight-easy.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Cook rice: 1¼ cups water, pinch of salt; boil, cover, low 15–18 minutes.
Whisk miso, maple, and soy sauce for glaze. Toss broccoli on a baking sheet with oil, salt, pepper, and sesame oil. Roast 10 minutes.
Pat salmon dry; place on the sheet with broccoli. Brush with miso glaze. Roast until salmon reaches 145°F and broccoli is tender, 10–12 minutes. Sprinkle sesame seeds.
Serve salmon and broccoli over rice; drizzle any remaining glaze.

salmon-tacos.name: Chili-Lime Salmon Tacos with Slaw
salmon-tacos.pitch: Spiced salmon in warm tortillas with crunchy lime slaw and crema — taco night upgrade.
steps: Zest and quarter lime. Pat salmon dry; season with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss coleslaw mix with juice from 1 lime wedge, honey, a pinch of salt, and half the lime zest. Mix sour cream with remaining zest and a squeeze of lime for crema.
Heat oil in a nonstick pan over medium-high. Cook salmon 3–4 minutes per side to 145°F; flake into chunks.
Warm tortillas. Fill with salmon, slaw, and crema. Serve with remaining lime.

teriyaki-salmon-bowl.name: Teriyaki Salmon Bowl with Edamame & Rice
teriyaki-salmon-bowl.pitch: Glazed teriyaki salmon over rice with edamame and cucumber — Protein Smart vibes.
steps: Cook rice with 1¼ cups water and salt: boil, cover, low 15–18 minutes. Thinly slice cucumber and scallions.
Pat salmon dry; season with salt. Heat oil in a pan over medium-high; cook skin-side down 5 minutes, flip 2–3 minutes. Add teriyaki; spoon over fish until glazed. Cook to 145°F.
Warm edamame (microwave or pan) with sesame oil and a pinch of salt.
Bowl rice; top with glazed salmon, edamame, cucumber, scallions, and sesame seeds.

steak-fajita-skillet.name: Sizzling Steak Fajita Skillet
steak-fajita-skillet.pitch: Strips of steak with peppers and onions, warm tortillas, and lime crema — fajita night without the fuss.
steps: Slice pepper and onion into strips. Zest and quarter lime. Pat steak dry; thinly slice against the grain. Toss steak with fajita spice, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Mix sour cream with lime zest and juice from 1 wedge for crema.

Heat oil in a large pan over high. Sear steak strips 2–3 minutes until browned; transfer out. Add more oil; cook pepper and onion until charred-tender, 4–5 minutes. Return steak; toss. Squeeze lime over top.
Warm tortillas. Serve steak and veggies with crema and remaining lime.

buffalo-chicken-wraps.name: Buffalo Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Blue Cheese
buffalo-chicken-wraps.pitch: Spicy buffalo chicken in crisp lettuce cups with blue cheese drizzle — low-carb heat.
steps: Separate lettuce leaves; wash and dry. Thinly slice celery.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high. Cook ground chicken with garlic powder, salt, and pepper, breaking up, until cooked through, 5–6 minutes (165°F).
Reduce heat; stir in butter and buffalo sauce until coated.
Fill lettuce cups with buffalo chicken and celery. Drizzle with blue cheese dressing. Serve.

chimichurri-steak-salad.name: Chimichurri Steak with Tomato Cucumber Salad
chimichurri-steak-salad.pitch: Seared steak with bright herb chimichurri over tomato-cucumber salad — zero dairy, high protein.
ingredients: 1 red chili or ½ tsp chili flakes (optional)
steps: Wash and dry produce. Finely chop parsley and garlic (and chili if using). Whisk with vinegar, 2 Tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper for chimichurri.
Chop romaine. Slice cucumber and onion; halve tomatoes. Toss salad veggies with a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Pat steak dry; season with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high; sear 3–5 minutes per side to 145°F. Rest 5 minutes; slice against the grain.
Plate salad; top with steak and spoon chimichurri over. Serve.

balsamic-steak-veggies.name: Balsamic Steak with Roasted Veggies
balsamic-steak-veggies.pitch: Sheet-pan peppers, zucchini, and onion with balsamic-glazed steak — dairy-free and veggie-forward.
ingredients: Olive oil, cooking oil, salt, pepper
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Slice zucchini into half-moons; slice pepper and onion into strips. Toss on a baking sheet with oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Roast 18–22 minutes until tender and browned.
Pat steak dry; season with rosemary, salt, and pepper. Heat oil in a pan over medium-high; sear 4–6 minutes per side to 145°F. Rest 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix balsamic vinegar, honey, and a drizzle of olive oil. Slice steak; drizzle with balsamic glaze. Serve with roasted veggies.

ginger-beef-broccoli.name: Ginger Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
ginger-beef-broccoli.pitch: Classic ginger beef with crisp broccoli over rice — skip the takeout.
ingredients: 1 Tbsp fresh ginger, minced (or 1 tsp ground)
steps: Cook rice with 1¼ cups water and a pinch of salt: boil, cover, low 15–18 minutes. Slice scallions; mince garlic and ginger. Mix soy, cornstarch, brown sugar, sesame oil, and 2 Tbsp water for sauce.
Heat oil in a large pan or wok on high. Stir-fry beef 2–3 minutes until browned; transfer out. Add broccoli and a splash of water; cover 2–3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 30 seconds. Return beef; pour in sauce; toss until glossy, 1–2 minutes. Serve over rice with scallions.

herb-roast-chicken-carrots.name: Herb-Roasted Chicken with Carrots & Green Beans
herb-roast-chicken-carrots.pitch: One-pan herb chicken with roasted carrots and green beans — dairy-free and simple.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Peel and cut carrots into sticks; trim green beans. Zest and quarter lemon.
Toss carrots and green beans on a sheet with oil, half the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Roast 10 minutes.

Pat chicken dry; season with thyme, paprika, remaining garlic powder, salt, pepper, and lemon zest. Add to sheet; drizzle with oil. Roast until chicken is 165°F and veggies are tender, 15–18 minutes. Squeeze lemon over and serve.

salmon-quinoa-bowl.name: Lemon Salmon Quinoa Bowl with Cucumber
salmon-quinoa-bowl.pitch: Roasted lemon salmon over quinoa with cucumber and herbs — dairy-free Protein Smart bowl.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Rinse quinoa; cook with 1½ cups water and a pinch of salt: boil, cover, low 15 minutes. Fluff. Zest and quarter lemon; slice cucumber.
Pat salmon dry; place on oiled sheet. Season with garlic powder, salt, pepper, lemon zest, and a drizzle of oil. Roast to 145°F, 10–12 minutes. Squeeze 1 lemon wedge over.
Toss quinoa with cucumber, herbs, olive oil, and juice from 1 lemon wedge. Plate bowls; top with salmon and remaining lemon.

shawarma-chickpea-bowls.name: Shawarma-Spiced Chickpea Bowls with Lemon Tahini
shawarma-chickpea-bowls.pitch: Crispy shawarma chickpeas over turmeric rice with cucumber-tomato salad and lemon tahini — filling plant protein with bright, fresh crunch.
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas (15 oz), drained and rinsed
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Drain and rinse chickpeas; pat very dry. Dice cucumber and halve tomatoes. Zest and quarter lemon; thinly slice half the red onion.
In a small pot, combine rice, turmeric, 1¼ cups water, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low, and cook until tender, 15–18 minutes. Fluff and keep covered.
Toss chickpeas on a baking sheet with shawarma spice, garlic powder, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast until browned and crisp, 18–22 minutes, shaking halfway.
In a small bowl, whisk tahini, lemon zest, juice from 2 lemon wedges, 1 Tbsp water, salt, and pepper. Add water a teaspoon at a time until drizzle-able.

Toss cucumber, tomatoes, and onion with a drizzle of olive oil, juice from 1 lemon wedge, salt, and pepper. Divide rice between bowls; top with crispy chickpeas and salad. Drizzle with lemon tahini and serve with remaining lemon wedges.

black-bean-zucchini-enchiladas.name: Black Bean & Zucchini Enchiladas with Avocado Salsa
black-bean-zucchini-enchiladas.pitch: Roasted zucchini and black beans wrapped in tortillas with smoky enchilada sauce, melted cheese, and cool avocado salsa.
ingredients: 1 can black beans (15 oz), drained and rinsed
steps: Adjust oven rack to middle and preheat to 425°F. Wash produce. Trim and dice zucchini into ½-inch pieces. Halve tomatoes, thinly slice scallions, drain beans, and quarter lime.
Toss zucchini and beans on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Roast until zucchini is browned and beans are warmed, 12–15 minutes.

Warm tortillas in the microwave under a damp paper towel for 30 seconds so they roll easily. Spread ½ cup enchilada sauce in the bottom of a small baking dish. Fill tortillas with roasted zucchini-bean mixture, roll snugly, and place seam-side down.
Top enchiladas with remaining sauce and cheese. Bake until sauce bubbles and cheese melts, 10–12 minutes.

Meanwhile, dice avocado and toss gently with tomatoes, half the scallions, juice from half the lime, salt, and pepper. Divide enchiladas between plates; top with avocado salsa and remaining scallions. Serve with remaining lime.

crispy-tofu-sesame-noodles.name: Crispy Tofu & Sesame Noodles with Snap Peas
crispy-tofu-sesame-noodles.pitch: Golden, cornstarch-crisped tofu tossed with sesame noodles, snap peas, and scallions — takeout-style flavor with a vegetable-forward balance.
ingredients: 6 oz spaghetti or ramen-style wheat noodles
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Drain tofu, wrap in a clean towel, and press gently to remove excess moisture. Cut into ¾-inch cubes. Peel carrot into ribbons or thin matchsticks; slice scallions, separating whites and greens.
In a small bowl, whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, sesame oil, and 2 Tbsp water. Toss tofu with cornstarch, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Cook noodles according to package directions, adding snap peas during the last 2 minutes. Drain and rinse briefly under cool water; toss with a small drizzle of oil.
Heat a thin layer of cooking oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high. Cook tofu, turning occasionally, until crisp and golden on most sides, 6–8 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

Add scallion whites and carrot to the pan; stir-fry until just tender, 2–3 minutes. Return tofu, add noodles and sauce, and toss until glossy and hot, 1–2 minutes. Divide between bowls; garnish with scallion greens and sesame seeds.

mediterranean-halloumi-couscous.name: Mediterranean Halloumi with Couscous & Roasted Vegetables
mediterranean-halloumi-couscous.pitch: Golden seared halloumi over fluffy couscous with roasted peppers, zucchini, and lemon-herb dressing — a satisfying meatless centerpiece.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Wash produce. Trim zucchini and cut into half-moons. Core and slice bell pepper. Peel and cut onion into ½-inch wedges. Zest and quarter lemon; mince garlic.
Toss zucchini, pepper, and onion on a baking sheet with olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Roast until browned and tender, 18–22 minutes.

Place couscous in a medium bowl. Pour in ¾ cup boiling water, cover tightly, and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork, then stir in parsley, lemon zest, half the garlic, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Pat halloumi dry and slice into ½-inch planks. Heat a dry nonstick pan over medium-high. Sear halloumi until golden on both sides, 2–3 minutes per side.

Whisk honey, juice from half the lemon, remaining garlic, 1 Tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper for dressing. Divide couscous and roasted vegetables between plates; top with halloumi and drizzle with dressing. Serve with remaining lemon.

pesto-vegetable-gnocchi.name: Pesto Vegetable Gnocchi with Roasted Tomatoes
pesto-vegetable-gnocchi.pitch: Pillowy gnocchi with blistered tomatoes, zucchini, spinach, and basil pesto — quick comfort food with plenty of vegetables.
steps: Wash produce. Quarter zucchini lengthwise and slice into ½-inch pieces. Halve tomatoes. Mince garlic and cut lemon into wedges.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook gnocchi until they float, 2–3 minutes. Reserve ½ cup cooking water, then drain.
Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high. Add zucchini and tomatoes; cook until zucchini is browned and tomatoes begin to blister, 4–5 minutes. Stir in garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add drained gnocchi and spinach. Toss until spinach wilts and gnocchi are lightly browned, 2–3 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in pesto and enough reserved water to coat.
Divide gnocchi between bowls. Sprinkle with Parmesan, season with salt and pepper, and squeeze lemon over top. Serve.

lentil-mushroom-shepherds-pie.name: Lentil & Mushroom Shepherd’s Pie with Cheddar Mash
lentil-mushroom-shepherds-pie.pitch: Savory lentils, mushrooms, peas, and carrots under a golden cheddar potato topping — hearty vegetarian comfort for a cozy night in.
ingredients: 1 can lentils (15 oz), drained and rinsed
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Wash potatoes; dice into ½-inch pieces. Slice mushrooms, peel and dice carrot, and finely dice onion.
Place potatoes in a medium pot and cover with salted water. Boil until tender, 12–15 minutes. Drain, return to pot, and mash with butter and milk. Season with salt and pepper; stir in cheddar.

Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Add mushrooms, carrot, and onion; cook until softened and browned, 6–8 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and thyme; cook 1 minute.
Stir in lentils, peas, broth, salt, and pepper. Simmer until thick and most liquid is absorbed, 4–5 minutes. Smooth into an even layer.
Dollop mashed potatoes over the filling and spread to the edges. Bake until topping is golden and filling bubbles, 12–15 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before spooning into bowls.
